svg.title: A nurse is preparing to reposition a client who weighs 250 lb (113 kg) and is unable to assist. Which of the following actions should the nurse take?
svg.desc: Safe patient handling means RAISING THE BED TO THE CAREGIVER'S WAIST HEIGHT DURING THE TASK, getting help, using lift sheets or mechanical lifts, keeping a wide base of support, and pivoting the whole body because TWISTING AT THE WAIST IS THE MOST COMMON CAUSE OF CAREGIVER BACK INJURY. The nurse lifts with the leg muscles by bending the knees, not the back, and keeps the load close to the center of gravity. The bed is returned to the LOWEST position after the task, for the client's fall safety.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP

A nurse is preparing to reposition a
client who weighs 250 lb (113 kg) and is
unable to assist. Which of the following
actions should the nurse take?
What fits here

waist before repositioning · Obtain
